verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: No direct data found for the B-Safe Gen2 specifically. General CPST guidance: rear-facing infant seats fit a Tacoma Access/Double Cab rear seat (Regular Cab is not rated for rear-facing); the front passenger seat often must slide forward, and only two seats fit comfortably across the second row (Toyota owner's manual + Cars.com 2016 Tacoma car-seat check).
